method: PIL header.size only; two exact installed pure smart_resize functions; no decode or tensors
data_exposure_note: Only the requested leading prompt exposures are audited; original prepared parquet remains intact. Exposure count does not imply distinct source examples.
limitations: Derived image grids, not materialized or measured tensors.
FP32 byte estimate is one complete copy only; runtime copy count and RSS are unknown.
Batch order follows parquet and current data.shuffle=False; other sampling changes require re-audit.

prefix_identity_audit.scope: First 9000 rows of each original 12000-row prepared parquet, corresponding to 300 contiguous batches of 30.
prefix_identity_audit.identity_origin: data_pipeline/build.py copies normalized r[id] into extra_info.record_id. RefCOCO uses refcoco:{ref_id}:{sent_id}; source_id alone stores sent_id, so record_id must not be reconstructed by simple concatenation.
prefix_identity_audit.identity_validation: Each repeated record_id has consistent source, source_id and question_sha256; zero identity collisions observed.
prefix_identity_audit.duplicate_definition: Duplicate exposures beyond first = exposures - distinct record_id count. Different questions sharing an image remain separate examples. This is identifier-level exposure deduplication, not semantic question deduplication or cross-source decontamination.
